- Do analog focused Mixed-Signal Verification

- Create and maintain verification plans

- Define verification metrics and set-up verification environments, including analog testbenches

- Good knowledge of object-oriented programming such as experience in C++, C#, SystemVerilog, etc.

jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

Wir machen das Leben einfacher, sicherer und umweltfreundlicher, mit Technik, die mehr leistet, weniger verbraucht und für alle verfügbar ist. Mikroelektronik von Infineon ist der Schlüssel für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Wir achten auf schonenden Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen und lösen gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen: Effiziente Energienutzung, umweltgerechte Mobilität und Sicherheit in einer vernetzten Welt. 2 Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div) ID: HRC1166867

Join us at KAI and become a key player in the semiconductor industry, where every design and test brings us closer to a sustainable, electrified future! As our new Staff Engineer specializing in Application Stress Test Methodologies, you¿ll dive into the world of next-generation wide-bandgap power semiconductors, designing innovative test systems that explore performance under extreme conditions.

At KAI, we strive to create pioneering reliability test methods and systems for robust power semiconductor technologies. Your know-how in designing and developing test systems will help us push our technology to its limits while collaborating with a team of innovators.

Your new responsibilities:

Develop and design advanced power electronic circuits through simulations and concept studies

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather and manage system requirements effectively

Transform designs into hardware, overseeing the complete implementation process, and supervising the manufacturing phase

Evaluate and validate designs within an industrial laboratory setting

Lead stress testing using both established and newly developed test systems

Document designs, concepts, and results with clarity and precision

You are a hands-on innovator with a passion for high-performing power electronic systems. You thrive on bringing ideas to life, blending technical understanding with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Your toolkit for success includes:

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong expertise in SPICE and system-level simulations of power electronic circuits

Proven experience in PCB design using industry-standard tools like ALTIUM Designer

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

jobs.occupation: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet.
